metadata.dataset_name: Werracle Unified Empirical OEV & Liquidation Dataset (2026)

ethereum_l1_findings.key_takeaway: Ethereum L1 liquidations are overwhelmingly dominated by block builder priority fees (MEV-Boost). Over 72% of liquidations yield less than $1.00 net, proving that external independent searchers cannot profitably hunt on L1 without private builder collusion.

base_l2_svr_findings.key_takeaway: Chainlink SVR Order Flow Auctions (OFA) capture ~98% of gross liquidation value for lending protocols. Median solver operational margin is compressed to -1.5%, with 61% of transactions breaking even or recording minor operational losses. SVR eliminates liquidation MEV margins entirely.

empirical_summary.paradigm_conclusion: Empirical evidence across both L1 (builder extraction) and L2 (SVR protocol recapture) conclusively proves that the era of profitable post-facto 'liquidation hunting' is dead. Sustainable value and protocol health can only be realized through pre-emptive self-deleveraging (Werracle Rescue Shield) before positions breach liquidation thresholds.
